items.title: Presentation by Annie Veilleux and Martin Cooper, ASI
notes: Re: Land Acknowledgement for Centre Wellington

Annie Veilleux gave a presentation outlining the land acknowledgment Project and the steps in development. She presented a history of the Indigenous presence in Centre Wellington and outlined the Indigenous Engagement in the development of the land acknowledgement.
Councillor Lustgarten Evoy inquired about sharing the reading of the Land Acknowledgement amongst Members of Council.
Councillor Wilton suggest a modification to the wording to “in the area now known as the Township of Centre Wellington.” Ms. Veilleux agreed that would be appropriate.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement for Centre Wellington
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated this is a first step in the action needed towards truth and reconciliation and noted staff is recommending the land acknowledgement be used at Council and Public Meetings and any official meetings with the indigenous community as well as workshops where there is a formal welcome.

items.title: 2023 Council and Committee Meeting Schedule
notes: Report from K. O’Kane, Manager of Legislative Services & Municipal Clerk

K. O’Kane, Manager of Legislative Services & Municipal Clerk outlined the meeting schedule and indicated an amended calendar will be brought forward once the advisory committees have been established.

items.title: Appointment of Members of Council to External Organizations and
notes: Committees
Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer
D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated this report appoints Councillors to external boards and committees as well as the appointment of a Deputy Mayor on a rotating basis.
Mayor Watters explained the schedule for the Deputy Mayor was chosen by lottery and he recommends the position be rotating in order to share in the responsibility and build the Council team.

items.title: Strategic Planning Update
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer updated Council on the Strategic Plan from the previous term of Council and indicated staff is requesting Council initiate the development of a new Strategic Plan for this term of Council.
Councillor Wilton requested clarification on the process used for the selection of a consultant to undertake Strategic Planning.

items.title: Ontario Lottery & Gaming (OLG) Agreement Amendment
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer reviewed the current contribution agreement for gaming revenue and indicated the amending agreement is required to allow contribution to the Township for sports betting at 4% to be allocated to the Township on a quarterly basis. D. Wilson further outlined the OLG contribution policy on how the funds received are utilized by the Township and further that the policy will be reviewed as part of the 2023 budget process.

items.title: 2023 Temporary Borrowing By-law
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated this is a housekeeping item which allows the Township to borrow funds in the event they are required between tax installments and represents good financial management.

items.title: 2023 Interim Tax Levy By-law
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated this by-law allows property tax bills to be generated in January and mailed to residents. He further explained the first and second installments are calculated based on 50% of the previous years levy. He highlighted the recommended change in installment due dates for commercial properties.

items.title: Request For Proposal #49-22 / Elora Wastewater Treatment Plant - Light
notes: Replacement Project
Report from S. Wiles, Purchasing & Risk Supervisor

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer outlined the Request for Proposal (RFP) process and indicated this proposal is under budget by $5 500. He further explained the purchasing by-law requires all RFP’s to be awarded by Council.

items.title: Victoria Park Senior Centre Constitution Update
notes: Report from P. Newson, Managing Director of Community Services P. Newson, Managing Director of Community Services outlined the responsibilities of the Victoria Park Senior Centre Board of Directors. She indicated the updates were initiated by the Board and were accepted by the general membership at the Annual General Meeting.

items.title: Fergus Elora Belwood Snowmobile Club Agreement
notes: Report from P. Newson, Managing Director of Community Services M. Tucker, Manager of Parks and Facilities Operations outlined the report and introduced the president of the snowmobile club present in the audience. He gave a brief history of the snowmobile club, outlined the season for snowmobiling in our geographic area as typically in January and February, reviewed the clubs responsibility for grooming trails and monitoring safety. He suggested staff has no concerns regarding insurance and liability for the Township under the proposed agreement.
In response to questions from Council, staff confirmed the trails are monitored by the OPP as well as the snowmobile club, and there are no additional risks to the Township.
